visual.renderer: macOS Quick Look thumbnails via qlmanage -t -s 1000
observations: Insertion marker visible and pushes report title downward. Existing report content overlaps its cover; baseline already overlaps.

Easy-read baseline and crop previews clip/overlap illustrations and text at left edge. No visible crop/rotation difference on these cover thumbnails; affected objects may be outside this limited view and renderer support is not established.
Forced raster fallback remains visible; no claim of native SVG preference or all-page equivalence.
Authored square wrapping places text beside image; top-bottom places text below. No visible authored-fixture clipping. Rotation/crop effect is not established by these thumbnails.
Authored occurrence replacement preview changes only first of two markers; explicit shared replacement changes both, without observed loss or clipping.
